subject: general
question: What is the recommended action if a DC motor produces excessive sparking at the brushes?

options.text: Replace worn-out brushes and clean the commutator
Add resistance to the armature circuit

solution:
**__Concept__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55bf8c057d2b34c606c4df7c5d981f1cab6f1030d79ec5583da02738797eee2e.png] 

 
• Brushes in a DC machine are used to provide an electrical connection between the rotating armature and the stationary external circuit.
 
• It collects current from the commutator (in a DC generator) and delivers it to the external load.
 
• It supplies current to the armature through the commutator
